text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Open one oven: the solver keeps flow and field as waves, where a curl is a multiplication. Products are easier on the grid: each step hops over and back. It trims the outer third of the waves, so products cannot fold back as fakes. A projection keeps both fields divergence-free; the smudging is solved exactly.
